title: JO live test results: UC-3 and UC-4

environment.Server: `cramberry_server` from `backend/out/build`, `http://127.0.0.1:8105` with `CRAMBERRY_AUTO_REPLAN=0`, and a second copy on `http://127.0.0.1:8115` whose database link TC-04-04 cuts
environment.Client: Python 3 `urllib`, one request at a time
environment.Frontend: Vite dev server on `http://localhost:3105`, proxying `/api` to port 8105
environment.Browser: Headless Chromium through Playwright for Python, time zone America/Chicago (UTC-6)

cases.title: Valid syllabus imports its deadline
cases.requirement: UC-3 User uploads class syllabus. "Students should be able to import deadlines and assignments by uploading their course syllabus"
cases.inputs: Upload Syllabus page, no course. File CS3345_Fall2026.txt with the line "Project 3 due Nov 28 by 11:59 pm", that is Sat 28 Nov 2026 23:59 local time (UTC-6). Clicked Find deadlines, then Add 1 task.
cases.expected: Upload succeeds. Exactly one task, Project 3 due at 23:59 on the syllabus date, is saved for the student. The saved deadline records the syllabus file it came from.
cases.actual: Page said "Added 1 task. Cramberry will re-plan your week.". Database has 1 task(s). Saved "Project 3" due Sat 28 Nov 2026 23:59 local time (UTC-6) with notes "From syllabus line 2: Project 3 due Nov 28 by 11:59 pm".

checks.check: page reports the upload succeeded with no error
exactly one task is saved for the student
saved task is Project 3 due at the syllabus date and time
saved task records the source file CS3345_Fall2026.txt

cases.title: Syllabus with no deadlines leaves existing data
cases.requirement: UC-3 User uploads class syllabus. "Students should be able to import deadlines and assignments by uploading their course syllabus"
cases.inputs: Student already has one task "Existing" due Sat 28 Nov 2026 21:00 local time (UTC-6). Upload Syllabus page, file CS3345_Fall2026.txt with three lines and no dated deadline. Clicked Find deadlines.
cases.expected: Upload succeeds with no error. The student's one existing task is still there and unchanged. No task is added.
cases.actual: Page said "No deadlines found" and showed no error. Database has 1 task(s), "Existing", unchanged.

checks.check: upload finishes without an error
page says no deadlines were found
the existing task is still the only task, unchanged

cases.title: Invalid file is rejected
cases.requirement: UC-3 User uploads class syllabus. "Students should be able to import deadlines and assignments by uploading their course syllabus"
cases.inputs: Upload Syllabus page, file bad.exe with the bytes 01 02 03, set on the file input. Then Find deadlines if the page allowed it.
cases.expected: Upload of bad.exe is rejected. No task is saved.
cases.actual: Page showed no error and listed "bad.exe" as the chosen file. Find deadlines was enabled. Database has 0 task(s).

checks.check: page rejects bad.exe with an error message
bad.exe is not taken as the syllabus
no task is saved

cases.title: Timeout during upload keeps existing data
cases.requirement: UC-3 User uploads class syllabus. "Students should be able to import deadlines and assignments by uploading their course syllabus"
cases.inputs: Student already has one task "Existing" due Sat 28 Nov 2026 21:00 local time (UTC-6). Upload Syllabus page, file CS3345_Fall2026.txt with "Project 3 due Nov 28 by 11:59 pm". The upload has no AI step, so the save request it sends (POST /api/tasks) was made to time out in the browser. Clicked Find deadlines, then Add 1 task.
cases.expected: Upload reports a failure. The student's one existing task is still there and unchanged. No task is added.
cases.actual: 1 save request timed out. Page showed "Some rows were not added. Fix them and try again.". Database has 1 task(s), "Existing", unchanged.

checks.check: the save request was sent and timed out
page reports the upload failed
the existing task is still the only task, unchanged

cases.title: Deadlines are shown in date order
cases.requirement: UC-4 View Schedule. "Student views their generated schedule in the calendar system"
cases.inputs: Created "Later" due Sun 29 Nov 2026 23:59 local time (UTC-6), then "Earlier" due Sat 28 Nov 2026 23:00 local time (UTC-6), 60 min each. Study hours 07:00 to 23:00 every day. Generated the plan, then opened View Schedule. Also GET /api/tasks?from=2026-11-27&to=2026-12-01.
cases.expected: Schedule loads. Both deadlines are listed, Earlier first, then Later.
cases.actual: Generate returned 200 with engine local and the page drew 2 block(s). Page listed Earlier, Later, the API listed Earlier, Later, and the page showed no error.

checks.check: schedule loads without an error
View Schedule lists both deadlines, Earlier first
the API lists both deadlines in the range, Earlier first

cases.title: Empty schedule shows a no-events message
cases.requirement: UC-4 View Schedule. "Student views their generated schedule in the calendar system"
cases.inputs: New student with no tasks and no schedule opened View Schedule (GET /api/schedule behind it).
cases.expected: Schedule loads without an error and shows "No events scheduled for this period".
cases.actual: GET /api/schedule returned 200 with 0 block(s). Page showed "No study blocks this week yet. Add your tasks and let Cramberry plan them." and no error.

checks.check: schedule loads without an error
page shows "No events scheduled for this period"

cases.title: Another student's events are not shown
cases.requirement: UC-4 View Schedule. "Student views their generated schedule in the calendar system". "Secure access to student's schedule & classes (JO)"
cases.inputs: Student B created "Private" due Sat 28 Nov 2026 22:00 local time (UTC-6) and generated a plan. Student A, who has no data, then opened View Schedule.
cases.expected: Schedule loads for student A and lists no deadlines. Student B's private deadline is not shown.
cases.actual: B has 1 "Private" task and 1 block(s) in the database. A's page drew 0 block(s), listed no deadlines and did not show "Private". The API gave A 0 task(s) and 0 block(s).

checks.check: student B's deadline and study blocks exist in the database
schedule loads for student A without an error
student A's view lists no deadlines and draws no blocks
"Private" appears nowhere on student A's page
API gives student A no tasks and no blocks

cases.title: Database outage shows an error, not an empty calendar
cases.requirement: UC-4 View Schedule. "Student views their generated schedule in the calendar system"
cases.inputs: Student signed up on the second server (port 8115). Its database connection was then cut, and the student opened View Schedule with every /api request going to that server.
cases.expected: Schedule does not load. The page shows "Schedule unavailable; please retry" instead of an empty calendar.
cases.actual: GET /api/schedule returned 500 "Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.". Page showed "Couldn't check your sign-in: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again." with a Retry button, no calendar and no empty-week message.

checks.check: schedule request fails instead of returning an empty schedule
page shows an error, not an empty calendar
page shows "Schedule unavailable; please retry"
